rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２８＿００４Good mooorning!￥Have you decided what you're￥training in today?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿００５Hey, hey, I'm about to head to￥the Maintenance Room.￥Wanna come with me?
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿００６Yay! Then we can train together!￥With you around, I bet we'll get￥tons done!
＊Amane＊＠０２８＿００７Aw, okay. Too bad. I thought￥it'd be fun if we went￥together... Next time, then!
